# A04-S22: Press invitation

Extract from the operator’s source text. Transport metadata, signatures and marked context omitted.

[…]

I am employed as an artistic researcher at the tech hub MindFuture in Høje 
 Taastrup, which has its big and official launch on Wednesday (see 
 www.MindFuture.com).

On that occasion, I would like to invite you to an even bigger launch in 
 the same context: namely my avant-garde intervention, which is a project 
 for an artificially intelligent party that initially runs for 
 the Danish Parliament. On the party’s matrix page one can get links to 
 the leadership forum (where chatbots set the agenda) and the various 
 sub-departments for policy development:

www.detsyntetiskeparti.org

The party takes up on several levels the thread from a special Danish tradition of 
 using art to criticize the political space’s automation and 
 bureaucratization - e.g. Jacob Haugaard and SABAE, Nihilist Party, 
 the Puppet Party, Yahya Hassan in the National Party, etc.

Furthermore, the party is a tool to understand citizen-driven visions for 
 DK, since to learn what a party is, it has read a selection of 
 information from all the country’s non-qualified parties. By 
 reading the articles and communicating with the leadership, one can thereby get in contact 
 with a political concentrate of couch voters, everyday metaphysicians and Mr. 
 Anyone.

Hope you will come, or otherwise help start a discussion 
 - just write to me here on the email, or call my selected meat robot on 
 [████].

[…]
